points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 尼采出生于普鲁士王国洛肯镇的一个新教牧师家庭。父亲是卡尔·路德维希·尼采，母亲为弗朗齐斯卡·尼采。1849年，父亲早逝，尼采与母亲和妹妹共同生活。这段经历使尼采很早就接触到宗教与死亡的主题。1858年，尼采进入普福尔塔寄宿学校，接受了严格的古典教育，这为他后来的古典哲学研究奠定了基础。在普福尔塔期间，尼采展现出卓越的学术才能，尤其对古典文学和哲学表现出浓厚兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Nietzsche was born in Röcken, Prussia, to a family of Lutheran ministers. His father died in 1849, leaving Nietzsche to be raised by his mother and sister. This early exposure to religion and death profoundly influenced his later philosophical work. In 1858, Nietzsche attended the prestigious Pforta boarding school, where he received rigorous classical education that laid the foundation for his later studies in classical philosophy and literature. During his time at Pforta, Nietzsche demonstrated exceptional academic talent, particularly showing a keen interest in classical literature and philosophy.

points.title: 大学求学时期
points.description: 1864年，尼采进入波恩大学学习神学和古典语文学，但很快放弃神学，专注于语文学。1865年，他转入莱比锡大学，继续古典语文学研究。在此期间，尼采结识了古典语文学教授里奇尔，成为其助手。1868-1869年，尼采完成了关于古希腊诗人狄奥尼索斯·希帕里诺斯的论文，展现出卓越的学术才能。这一时期，尼采开始阅读叔本华的著作，深受其影响，同时开始构思自己的哲学体系，为后来的思想发展奠定基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1864, Nietzsche enrolled at the University of Bonn to study theology and classical philology, but soon abandoned theology in favor of philology. In 1865, he transferred to the University of Leipzig, where he continued his studies in classical philology. During this time, Nietzsche became acquainted with Professor Ritschl, under whom he worked as an assistant. Between 1868-1869, Nietzsche completed his work on the ancient Greek poet Dionysius of Halicarnassus, demonstrating exceptional academic talent. This period marked Nietzsche's first encounter with Schopenhauer's writings, which profoundly influenced him, and he began formulating his own philosophical system that would later develop into his mature thought.

points.title: 学术生涯与早期著作
points.description: 1869年，年仅24岁的尼采被任命为巴塞尔大学古典语文学教授，成为当时最年轻的教授之一。1870年，他短暂参与普法战争担任医疗救护工作，目睹战争的残酷后对民族主义产生怀疑。1872年，尼采发表第一部重要著作《悲剧的诞生》，提出阿波罗精神与狄奥尼索斯精神的对立统一理论，挑战当时盛行的瓦格纳音乐和德国文化。1873-1876年，他发表《不合时宜的考察》系列，批判德国文化和学术。1878年，尼采发表《人性，太人性了》，标志着他思想从古典语文学向哲学的彻底转变，并开始与瓦格纳决裂。
points.descriptionEn: In 1869, at the age of 24, Nietzsche was appointed Professor of Classical Philology at the University of Basel, becoming one of the youngest professors in Germany. In 1870, he briefly served as a medical orderly during the Franco-Prussian War, where witnessing the brutality of war led to his skepticism toward nationalism. In 1872, Nietzsche published his first major work, 'The Birth of Tragedy,' in which he introduced his theory of the Apollonian and Dionysian dichotomy, challenging the prevailing Wagnerian culture and German intellectualism. Between 1873-1876, he published the 'Untimely Meditations,' a series of essays critiquing German culture and academia. In 1878, Nietzsche published 'Human, All Too Human,' marking his definitive shift from classical philology to philosophy and his break with Wagner.

points.placeEn: Various locations in Switzerland and Italy
points.title: 游历创作与思想成熟
points.description: 1880年起，尼采开始在欧洲各地游历，主要在瑞士和意大利的山城之间移动，寻找适合写作的气候和环境。这一时期，他的创作进入高峰期，发表了《快乐的科学》(1882)、《查拉图斯特拉如是说》(1883-1885)、《超越善恶》(1886)、《道德谱系学》(1887)等重要著作。1889年1月，都灵街头，尼采目睹一匹马被虐待，冲上前抱住马痛哭，随后精神崩溃。这一标志性事件标志着他哲学创作的终结。在崩溃前，尼采完成了《偶像的黄昏》和《尼采反瓦格纳》等著作，形成了完整的哲学体系。他的游历生活虽然孤独，但提供了思考的空间，使他能够远离学术圈，专注于创作。
points.descriptionEn: Starting in 1880, Nietzsche began wandering across Europe, primarily moving between mountain towns in Switzerland and Italy, seeking a climate and environment conducive to his writing. During this period, his creative work reached its peak, with the publication of major works including 'The Gay Science' (1882), 'Thus Spoke Zarathustra' (1883-1885), 'Beyond Good and Evil' (1886), and 'On the Genealogy of Morality' (1887). In January 1889, in Turin, Nietzsche witnessed the beating of a horse, rushed to embrace the animal and weep, after which he suffered a complete mental breakdown. This iconic event marked the end of his philosophical career. Before his breakdown, Nietzsche completed works such as 'The Twilight of the Idols' and 'Nietzsche contra Wagner,' forming his complete philosophical system. Although his wandering life was lonely, it provided him with the space to think and distance himself from academic circles, allowing him to focus on his creative work.

points.title: 晚年与身后影响
points.description: 1889年精神崩溃后，尼采被妹妹伊丽莎白·尼采护送回德国，先后在巴塞尔、耶拿接受治疗。1890年起，由妹妹照料生活在魏玛。尽管尼采已无法创作，但他的妹妹伊丽莎白开始整理和编辑他的遗稿，有时甚至按照自己的理解修改和扭曲尼采的思想。1900年8月25日，尼采在魏玛去世，享年55岁。去世后，尼采的思想被不同政治力量所利用和解释，尤其是尼采的妹妹与纳粹合作，将他的思想扭曲为纳粹意识形态的一部分。直到二战后，尼采的哲学才被重新客观评价，对存在主义、后现代主义等哲学流派产生深远影响，成为20世纪最重要的哲学家之一。
points.descriptionEn: After his mental breakdown in 1889, Nietzsche was escorted back to Germany by his sister Elisabeth Nietzsche and received treatment in Basel and Jena. From 1890 onward, he was cared for by his sister in Weimar. Although Nietzsche was no longer able to create, his sister Elisabeth began to organize and edit his posthumous works, sometimes modifying and distorting his ideas according to her own understanding. On August 25, 1900, Nietzsche died in Weimar at the age of 55. After his death, Nietzsche's philosophy was appropriated and interpreted by various political forces, particularly as his sister collaborated with the Nazis to distort his ideas into part of Nazi ideology. It was only after World War II that Nietzsche's philosophy was re-evaluated more objectively, profoundly influencing philosophical schools such as existentialism and postmodernism, establishing him as one of the most important philosophers of the 20th century.

appraisal.zh: 尼采通常被看作现代思想的关键转折人物，其“上帝已死”成为现代性自我反思的经典表述，对存在主义与后现代主义影响深远，近年学界也愈益认识其思想的复杂与深度。不过另一种看法认为，他的“权力意志”与“超人”带有精英主义、反民主倾向，对女性及某些民族的贬抑言论广受批评，思想的模糊与矛盾也易被曲解，纳粹的利用即是显例。
appraisal.en: Nietzsche is generally seen as a pivotal figure in modern thought: his proclamation that God is dead became a classic expression of modernity's self-reflection, and his influence on existentialism and postmodernism runs deep, with scholarship increasingly recognizing the complexity of his thought. Another view, however, holds that his will to power and Übermensch carry elitist and anti-democratic tendencies, that his derogatory remarks about women and certain peoples have drawn wide criticism, and that the ambiguity and contradictions of his philosophy make it easy to distort—the Nazi appropriation being a clear case.

supporter.zh: 尼采被支持者视为现代思想的先驱和真理的勇敢探索者。他挑战传统道德体系，提出'上帝已死'的命题，促使人类重新评估价值基础。尼采的'超人'哲学激励人们超越自我局限，追求更高的人生境界。他对生命肯定的态度和'永恒轮回'的思想，为现代人提供了面对虚无的积极方案。尼采的文学才华和独特的哲学表达方式，使他的作品超越了纯粹的学术范畴，成为激励无数艺术家、思想家和个人的精神源泉。
supporter.en: Supporters view Nietzsche as a pioneer of modern thought and a courageous explorer of truth. By challenging traditional moral systems and proclaiming 'God is dead,' Nietzsche prompted humanity to reevaluate the foundations of values. His concept of the 'Übermensch' (Overman) inspires people to transcend their limitations and pursue higher states of existence. His affirmative attitude toward life and the idea of 'eternal recurrence' offer a positive approach to confronting nihilism. Nietzsche's literary talent and unique philosophical expression have elevated his works beyond pure academia, making them a source of inspiration for countless artists, thinkers, and individuals.

critic.zh: 批评者指出尼采思想中的矛盾和危险之处。他的'权力意志'理论被批评为可能为强权政治辩护，其反民主倾向和对'超人'的推崇被质疑为精英主义和反平等思想。尼采对女性和某些民族的贬低言论也受到广泛批评。此外，尼采思想的模糊性和矛盾性使其容易被不同政治力量所利用和曲解，尤其是纳粹对尼采思想的扭曲利用。批评者还认为尼采的哲学过于强调个人意志，忽视了社会结构和集体责任的重要性，可能导致极端个人主义和社会解体。
critic.en: Critics point out the contradictions and dangers in Nietzsche's thought. His theory of 'will to power' has been criticized as potentially justifying authoritarian politics, and his anti-democratic tendencies and glorification of the 'Übermensch' have been questioned as elitist and anti-egalitarian. Nietzsche's derogatory remarks about women and certain ethnic groups have also faced widespread criticism. Furthermore, the ambiguity and contradictions in his philosophy have made it susceptible to appropriation and misinterpretation by various political forces, particularly the Nazi distortion of his ideas. Critics also argue that Nietzsche's philosophy overemphasizes individual will while neglecting the importance of social structures and collective responsibility, potentially leading to extreme individualism and social disintegration.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，尼采被定义为现代性的关键转折点人物。他的思想标志着西方哲学从理性主义向非理性主义的转变，影响了存在主义、后现代主义等众多思潮。尼采的'上帝已死'命题成为现代性自我反思的经典表述，他的'权力意志'和'永恒轮回'等概念已成为流行文化中的常见符号。尽管尼采的哲学常被简化为'超人'和'反基督'等标签，但学术界越来越认识到其思想的复杂性和深度。尼采的生平，尤其是其晚年精神崩溃，也成为哲学史上最引人入胜的传奇之一，使他的哲学与个人命运紧密相连。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Nietzsche is defined as a pivotal figure in modernity. His thought marks a transition in Western philosophy from rationalism to irrationalism, influencing numerous schools of thought including existentialism and postmodernism. Nietzsche's proclamation of 'God is dead' has become a classic formulation of modern self-reflection, and concepts such as 'will to power' and 'eternal recurrence' have become common symbols in popular culture. Although Nietzsche's philosophy is often reduced to simplistic labels like 'Übermensch' and 'anti-Christ,' academia increasingly recognizes the complexity and depth of his thought. Nietzsche's life, particularly his later mental breakdown, has become one of the most captivating legends in the history of philosophy, intimately connecting his philosophical work with his personal destiny.

self.zh: 人之所以伟大，是因为他是一座桥梁而非目的。
self.en: Man is something that shall be overcome. What have you done to overcome him?
